phase: Frozen discovery protocol; not verification or acceptance

maintainerDirection.scope: Continue planned negative-comparator branch with native/experimental/empty; third parties excluded; no budget approval

excluded.button-card-v7.0.1: Failed ordinary keyboard pilot; no exception
excluded.mushroom-v5.3.0: Failed ordinary keyboard pilot; no exception

environment.layout: Masonry allocated by HA; native three Tile surfaces per group, experimental fixed three internal buttons
environment.content: First reading, Second reading, Body intent; synthetic A/B sources; independent A/B/body targets
environment.allocation: HA affinity two allowed cores; browser/driver use host affinity; no per-container CPU or memory limit claimed
environment.network: All-namespace HA, loopback relay; browser proxy rejects non-loopback; service workers blocked; no request routing

order: Modes loads, updates, interactions, editors serially. Count 1 then 10; repeat outer, rotate [empty,native,experimental] left by repeat. One measured context at a time plus control page. Renew auth outside windows.

loads.cold: New browser context and explicit cache clear per pair; HTTP caches enabled
loads.warm: Same-context reload immediately after cold; actual ResourceTiming and CDP cache flags retained

interactions.input: CDP mousePressed then mouseReleased at precomputed first-A button center; 2000 ms dispatch timeout; original target off throughout

editors.empty: Edit-mode setup context only; editorMs null

endpoints.load: Post-navigation CDP TaskDuration/ScriptDuration totals, ms; document+resource transferSize bytes through fonts/two-frame readiness boundary; shared/custom separated descriptively
endpoints.update: Same-document TaskDuration/ScriptDuration deltas, elapsed duration, host send lateness, existing compressed entity delivery counts and final state; no extra server subscription
endpoints.interaction: Separately measured update+input windows; pointerdown event.timeStamp to capture entry (queue), capture entry to local intent, event to local intent, click stamp/entry, actual counts/targets and host intended/send/return times
endpoints.editor: First-open and same-document reopen; setup, actual editor ready and CDP work; automation included; does not reapprove existing editor acceptance

invalidWindow: Sent/delivered count or final state mismatch
Duplicate/missing/wrong-target activation, timeout or input observer count mismatch
Driver tick later than one update period
invalidation.lateInputs: Retain exact intended/send/return timestamps, including timeouts; no hidden drop
invalidation.missing: Publish coverage gap and reason; acceptance remains pending
invalidation.resourceFailure: Unexpected custom assets, non-loopback resource or service worker aborts affected collection, retaining attempts
invalidation.fatal: Preserve incomplete output and stop affected campaign; no silent retry

capacity.guard: External one-second sandbox supervisor plus statfs check before every scalar write; stop on reserve crossing

boundaries: Whole dashboard shared costs, never exact per-card subtraction
Negative third-party feasibility; no third-party ranking
Desktop headless lab only; no inferred phone conversion
Presentation, HA transport and physical response unmeasured
Cold historical failures, retention and presentation stay independent; stage 1 open
Discovery cannot be relabeled fresh approval-backed acceptance
